beliefs: f applies a Caesar shift of +2 in ASCII to every character, including uppercase, digits, punctuation, and spaces [E1, E2, E3]

Uppercase letters shift by +2: A->C, H->J, W->Y, X->Z, Y->[, Z->\ [E2, E3]
